carpet.rule.playerLadder.name: Player Ladder
carpet.rule.playerLadder.desc: Master switch for the Player Ladder feature. When off, right-clicking an entity does nothing.
carpet.rule.playerLadderClickMode.name: Player Ladder Click Mode
carpet.rule.playerLadderClickMode.desc: What a right click on an entity does: ride it, pick it up, or do nothing. Values: ride, pick_up, do_nothing.
carpet.rule.playerLadderPickUpLimit.name: Player Ladder Pick Up Limit
carpet.rule.playerLadderPickUpLimit.desc: Maximum number of stacked passengers considered when picking up an entity.
carpet.rule.playerLadderStepUpLimit.name: Player Ladder Step Up Limit
carpet.rule.playerLadderStepUpLimit.desc: Maximum stack height climbed when riding an entity.
carpet.rule.playerLadderInteractWithAnyL: Player Ladder Interact With Any Living
Whether non-player living entities can also be ridden or picked up.
carpet.rule.playerLadderExcludedEntities: Comma separated entity ids or tags (prefix with #) that can never be ridden or picked up.
carpet.rule.playerLadderDismountOnGameMo: Player Ladder Dismount On Game Mode Change
Whether passengers are dismounted when the carrier changes game mode.
carpet.rule.playerLadderRideExtension.de: Whether stacks of 3 or more players are allowed. When false, only two players may ride each other.
carpet.rule.playerLadderRideFakePlayer.d: Whether Carpet fake players can be ridden or picked up.
carpet.rule.playerLadderClientInteractio: Client side aiming fix that keeps riders selectable while stacked. Client only.
